scripts.test:watch: concurrently "watchman-make -p 'firestore.template.rules' --run 'npm run generate:firestore:rules && npm run test'" "jest --watch"
scripts.test:emulator: npm run generate:firestore:rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore 'npm run test'
scripts.emulator:free-port: lsof -i :9151 | grep LISTEN | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill -9
scripts.deploy:firestore:rules: npm run generate:firestore:rules && npm run use:env && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules --token $FIREBASE_TOKEN
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run use:env && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:storage: npm run use:env && firebase deploy --only storage
